name: mission-dsl-runtime
title: Mission DSL and deterministic runtime
description: Implement the software-only G4 typed mission DSL, immutable validated IR, deterministic event reducer, action correlation and cancellation scopes.
creator: mj
notes: Software-only G4 complete: immutable bounded IR (64 nodes, 8 direct children/resources), static 64-active/256-invocation budgets, deterministic zero-allocation runtime, exact command correlation and terminal-evidence cancellation. Eighteen mission tests and full CI pass. Startup-only Box indirection is documented; remote action, lease, target timing and Orange Pi qualification remain separate gates.
